landing.hero_desc: Empowering smallholder poultry farmers across Africa with offline-first farm telemetry, YOLOv8 video flock counting, and respiratory distress audio classification. Built to operate reliably in low-connectivity rural environments.
landing.engineered_desc: Our platform merges state-of-the-art vision models and low-connectivity system designs to serve the unique operational environments of African smallholders.
landing.local_desc: Powered by IndexedDB caching. Records feed quantities, water consumption, weight samples, and vaccination logs completely offline. Saves modifications to a sync queue and pushes data automatically once network recovery occurs.
landing.yolov8_desc: Processes video frames using lightweight YOLOv8 models. Measures bird counts, spatial distribution densities, and alerts operations if flocks show low mobility or cluster patterns indicating cold temperature stress.
landing.acoustic_desc: Machine Learning inference running locally analyzes flock vocalizations. Detects respiratory anomalies, coughing patterns, or thermal distress chirps before visible symptoms appear.
landing.test_drive_desc: Interact with a simplified version of our core ML modules and data views right here in the browser.
landing.open_source_desc: AgriSense AI is committed to open-source agricultural tooling. Our core computer vision models and local-first architecture are publicly available for researchers, NGOs, and developers building the future of African farming.
landing.all_rights: All rights reserved. Designed for sub-Saharan agricultural enablement.
landing.join_beta: Join our pilot program and digitize your flock telemetry today.

tour.step1_content: This panel shows your current active farm site and your authorized user access role level. Changing farms instantly reloads all dashboard analytics and AI feeds.
tour.step2_content: Built for remote farms, the app caches data in IndexedDB when you lose connection. A glowing Sync Drawer will appear here allowing you to force-sync queued telemetry once back online.
tour.step3_content: Critical anomalies like missing bird count disparities from YOLO scans, acoustic distress alerts, or high mortality triggers show up here for immediate operator response.
tour.step4_content: Use these shortcuts to log feed consumption, record weight samples, open live camera streams, or view clinical medication tables.
tour.step5_content: Click here to navigate to the daily logs ledger and view aggregated consumption charts.
tour.step6_content: In this table, you can export Excel-friendly CSV spreadsheets or open paper-optimized PDF ledgers to print and post on coop walls.
tour.step7_content: Let's explore the Flock Health module, which contains clinical logs and treatment planning tools.
tour.step8_content: Here you can proactively schedule future vaccinations and vitamin cycles. The system will send browser push notifications when a treatment is due.
tour.step9_content: Now let's switch to the AI Visual Monitor to see how we track the flock.
tour.step10_content: Here you can monitor live streams. Bounding box overlays track node IDs, huddling alerts, and estimate chicken populations in real-time.
tour.step11_content: Finally, let's explore our advanced sound analytics for early disease detection.
tour.step12_content: Connect your local microphone to capture ambient noise. Our heuristic classifier analyzes spectral centroids to detect respiratory distress (sneezing/coughing) or environmental stress (loud chirping).
